chunks: And Jamil narrated from Zurarah, from one of them both, peace be upon them:
Regarding a man who forcibly violated a Muslim woman, he said: “He is to be killed.”

key_terms.غَصَبَ امْرَأَةً مُسْلِمَةً نَفْسَهَا: Forcibly violated a Muslim woman against her will
key_terms.يُقْتَلُ: He is to be killed; a ruling of execution

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a man who forcibly violates a Muslim woman in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a man who forcibly violates a Muslim woman. The Imam عليه السلام states that the prescribed ruling in this case is execution, showing the gravity of this crime in Islamic law.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5041 - Jamil narrated from Zurarah, from one of the Imams (peace be upon them), regarding a man who forcibly violated a Muslim woman.
Imam (as) said: "He is to be killed."
